# FLX-3304: a column fell back to a type default and coverage is strict

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Every column of an exposed table is produced by a declaration, a profile, a copy of a runtime attribute or a derivation. A column none of those reaches falls back to its type's default: null for an optional column of a scenario-driven emit that no mapping step resolved, the simulation's time bounds for a DATE or TIMESTAMP column of a generator-driven emit that declares no draw of its own. That is reported on every plan; under --strict-coverage, or when the Simulation declares strictCoverage: true under its com.agentics.flux/1 extensions, it is refused, before any row exists, with one table row per column. Cover a column of a scenario-driven emit by mapping it with the emit's mapping block, or by giving the run an attribute of its own name; declaring it under fidelity.columns would make the whole emit generator-driven. Cover a DATE or TIMESTAMP column of a generator-driven emit by declaring a range, a rate, or bins with binWeights for it under the emit's fidelity.columns. Or drop --strict-coverage, and strictCoverage from the Simulation if it declares it, to accept the default.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3304
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
